points: Battery is the biggest upgrade over the 15 Pro
Samsung S26 Ultra still wins on night zoom, according to a community battle
Worth it mainly if you keep the phone for several years
answer.text: Most owners rate it highly (about 4.3/5) for battery life, video and display, but the price and weight are the common complaints. Early reviews were near-perfect; recent ones mention battery drain after an update.

desc: Apple's biggest flagship this year. Is the upgrade worth it from a 15 or 16 Pro? #iphone17
title: iPhone 17 Pro Max
